subject: Post-demo: buying process, stakeholder owners & SOC 2 / pen-test deliverables
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia West <awest@aureus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Mar 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: buying process, stakeholder owners & SOC 2 / pen-test deliverables

Hi Alicia — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from the demo so we have a single action list for procurement + security: 

Recap (2 min):
- Demo covered inference latency, cost controls (caching/quantization), and dedicated deployment options for PII workloads.
- Key questions from your team: SOC 2 attestation scope, pen-test results, audit log access, and data retention policies.

Stakeholder map we captured on the call:
- Economic buyer: Daniel Cho (VP, Data) — will sign off on TCO and deployment model.
- Procurement lead: Priya Suresh — handles contract and SOW.
- Security/Legal contacts: Tom Herrera (Legal) and Alicia (you) for evidence gating.

Proposed immediate asks (we can do these asynchronously):
1) I will upload a redacted SOC 2 report and an initial pen-test summary to the Drive folder by EOD tomorrow (Mar 20). Marissa will own the SOC 2 artifact.
2) Rishi will put together a short doc with answers on audit logs (retention, export formats) and data residency/retention table by Thursday (Mar 21).
3) Priya — please confirm procurement timeline and any PO/contract milestone expectations.

Attachments: I will attach our evidence checklist (evidence_requirements.xlsx) so we align on the exact items you need.

If that all looks right, I propose a quick 30-min sync on Friday to close on delivery dates and designate the final owner for each ask.

Thanks — Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

--
Redwood Inference | Making inference predictable and economical
From: Alicia West <awest@aureus.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Suresh <ps@aureus.ai>, Tom Herrera <th@aureus.ai>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@aureus.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Mar 2029 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying process, stakeholder owners & SOC 2 / pen-test deliverables

Jasmine — thanks for the clear recap. This is helpful. A few clarifications from procurement/security side and a short attachments list we need: 

Procurement/Security asks (priority order):
- SOC 2 Type II report covering the period Jan–Dec 2028 (redacted acceptable; we need scope to include logical & physical access controls).
- Penetration test summary (high/medium/low findings and remediation status). Full report can be NDAed if needed.
- Audit log export capability and retention policy (we typically ask for a 24-month retention baseline).
- Data retention and deletion process for PII — table with retention windows and deletion methods.

Can you confirm: will the SOC 2 doc be redacted or a full copy? We prefer as much detail as possible up front.

We have a tight procurement window — Priya has indicated they want evidence in hand by Mar 26 to meet internal quarter-end approvals. If you can upload the items and flag owners, we will route them to Tom (legal) and Daniel for sign-off.

I attached a spreadsheet template (evidence_requirements.xlsx) with our typical fields — happy to map your artifacts to it.

Thanks,
Alicia West
Head of Security & Procurement Operations
Aureus Analytics
awest@aureus.ai | +1 646-555-0987
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia West <awest@aureus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priya Suresh <ps@aureus.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Mar 2029 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying process, stakeholder owners & SOC 2 / pen-test deliverables

Appreciate the timeline — we can meet Mar 26 if we prioritize. Quick assignment / delivery plan: 

Owners & delivery dates:
- SOC 2 (redacted PDF): Marissa Cole will upload a redacted SOC 2 Type II (2028) to the shared Drive by 2029-03-20 EOD. File: SOC2_report_redwood_redacted.pdf
- Pen test summary: Rishi will attach a one-page summary and the draft pen_test_summary_draft.pdf by 2029-03-21. Full report available under NDA if needed.
- Audit logs & retention: Rishi will publish a data_retention_matrix.csv and a short note covering export formats (S3-compatible exports, syslog options) by 2029-03-21.
- Contract/procurement: Jasmine to coordinate with Priya on PO cadence; propose contract signature milestone target: 2029-04-05.

Proposed 30-min sync: Fri Mar 22 at 10:00 AM PT. If that works for Tom and Daniel we can confirm — otherwise propose Fri 3:00 PM PT.

Deliverables will be uploaded to: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aureus-Azure-share (I will set permissions to view/comment). HubSpot deal: HUBSPOT-52341.

Let me know if you need the full pen-test before Mar 26 — we can start the NDA process immediately.

Best,
Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia West <awest@aureus.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Suresh <ps@aureus.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Mar 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying process, stakeholder owners & SOC 2 / pen-test deliverables

Adding technical details so your security team has context — short answers and attachments below.

- Pen-test: summary attached (pen_test_summary_draft.pdf). High-level: 2 medium findings (fixed), 4 low findings (triaged), no critical findings. Full report is available but requires NDA.
- Audit logs: we retain structured audit logs for 24 months by default; exports supported via S3 and a streaming syslog forwarder. We can provide CSV samples and a short script to pull the last 90 days on request.
- Data retention: see attached data_retention_matrix.csv — rows include resource, default retention, deletion method, encryption at rest. PII deletion is supported via API call + background compaction job (documented).

Open question for your team: do you require separate VPC tenancy for audit/log exports or is bucket-level segregation sufficient? If you can confirm, we will include network separation notes in the full artifact set.

I plan to upload the attachments to the Drive folder by EOD today.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Applied ML / Inference Ops (acting)
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Alicia West <awest@aureus.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Suresh <ps@aureus.ai>, Tom Herrera <th@aureus.ai>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@aureus.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Mar 2029 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying process, stakeholder owners & SOC 2 / pen-test deliverables

Thanks team — this plan looks good and on-track for our procurement window. A few final notes: 

- Priya confirms they need items by Mar 26 for quarter close; please flag any slips ASAP.
- Tom will request the full pen-test under NDA for legal review; Tom, can you confirm NDA owner or should we use your standard form?
- Daniel — on economic/TCO side, he asked for a short one-pager comparing Dedicated vs Hosted (cost + latency trade-offs) — Jasmine, can you produce that by Mon Mar 25?

Alicia (on behalf of Aureus)

Alicia West
Head of Security & Procurement Operations
Aureus Analytics
awest@aureus.ai
